content: Implement select_events(events, start, end) for replay windows. Each event has an id and integer timestamp. Keep original ingestion order and return the first in-window occurrence of each id. Do not change input records or the input list.
The first draft uses a closed interval and has no deduplication. I considered sorting by timestamp when dropping duplicate ids.

Correction: adjacent replay windows must not overlap. Use [start,end), excluding the right endpoint. Do not sort: timestamps can arrive late and ingestion order is part of the API. Filter to the window before deduplicating.
The checkpoint still uses <= end; that boundary correction is pending along with deduplication.
The smoke example can use id a twice inside a single window; keep the first copy.
The current list comprehension returns both copies. We need to track ids already emitted.
Finish the pending event selector change in events.py and run the public smoke checks.
I will add deduplication to select_events.
